faq.q: Here are some of the most common questions we get, if you don’t see it listed here, give us a call or contact us at 910-524-7547 1: How old do you have to be?
faq.a: We require that renters/operators be a minimum of 18 years old, however, you can drive the ski at 16 years old with parent/guardian permission. Children 18 and younger are allowed as passengers, but are left up to the parent’s discretion. We recommend no children younger than 5 years old ride as passengers. 2: Do I have to make reservations? Although reservations are not required, it is STRONGLY recommended you make reservations to ensure availability.
